panes.title: EVERY KAS THAT WILL EVER EXIST

panes.note: *96.60 percent* mined, 3.40 percent still to come.

post.x: 96.60 percent of every KAS that will ever exist is already mined. 976,205,823 KAS are still to come, and 99 percent is reached in may 2028 at the current schedule. what comes after keeps halving every twelve months.
post.reply: the full emission schedule is on kaspapulse.com/kaspa-halving.html. the remaining amount shrinks and never quite reaches the maximum.
